# Hermes Agent: Complete Reference & FAQ

### 1. Platform & Installation Setup
- **Windows Support**: Windows 10/11 is Tier 1 supported natively via the PowerShell installer (`install.ps1`). WSL2 is only required if using the Web Dashboard's embedded terminal `/chat` pane (which requires a POSIX PTY).
- **Docker & NAS Deployments**: Multi-arch Docker images (`nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest`) support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` (Raspberry Pi, Apple Silicon). For NAS environments (UGOS Pro, Synology, unRAID) with volume permission errors, pass `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) to remap container user permissions.
- **Android / Termux**: Installer automatically detects Termux, sets temp directories to `$TMPDIR`, and selects the curated `[termux-all]` dependency bundle.
- **Web Dashboard**: Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the local web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:9119` with embedded browser chat.
- **Update Latency**: Node.js update delays during `hermes update` occur when Camofox silently downloads browser binaries during npm postinstall.

---

### 2. Model Providers & Connectivity
- **Local Ollama & Small Models (4B–9B)**: Full tool schemas (~45 tools) are sent on every turn. Improve speed by disabling unused tools (`hermes tools`), using faster quantizations, switching to 32B+ models, or setting `terminal.backend: local`.
- **Localhost Ignored / Auth 401s**: If `provider: auto` detects remote keys (e.g., `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) and ignores local `base_url`, set `provider: custom` and `base_url: http://localhost:11434` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.
- **Ollama Cloud**: Configure provider as `ollama-cloud`, which automatically routes to the OpenAI-compatible `https://ollama.com/v1` endpoint.
- **Vision Support**: Add `supports_vision: true` under your custom/Ollama model config to enable native image payloads.
- **Azure AI Foundry**: Set `provider: azure-foundry` and export `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` (run `hermes setup`). Claude Code specific variables are ignored.
- **Google Gemini**: Legacy `google-gemini-cli` and `google-antigravity` OAuth flows are removed. Use Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY` (`provider: gemini`), or Vertex AI.
- **Claude Pro/Max Subscriptions**: API keys always bill per-token. To use Pro/Max subscription quotas, authenticate via OAuth instead of an API key.
- **DeepSeek Normalization**: Ensure Hermes is updated so `deepseek-v4-flash` is not normalized to `deepseek-chat` (which routes to `deepseek-v4-pro`).
- **Usage Tracking (`/usage`)**: OpenAI-compatible streaming endpoints (e.g., LocalAI) receive `stream_options: {include_usage: true}` and forward model-level `extra_body`.
- **Model Routing Policy**: Automatic complexity-based routing (`smart_model_routing`) is not supported. Use manual selection (`/model`, `hermes chat -m <model>`) or set subagent models via `delegation.model`.

---

### 3. Messaging Gateways & Personas
- **Interactive Setup**: Run `hermes gateway setup` to configure Discord, Telegram, and other platforms via CLI prompts.
- **Telegram Authorization**: `allowed_chats` is a group-chat filter, not DM auth. To authorize DM users, add numeric IDs to `telegram.allow_from` (`TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS`), approve pairing via `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`, or set `telegram.allow_all: true`.
- **File & Media Handling**:
  - *Inbound*: Small code/text files (`.py`, `.txt`) are injected into the prompt; other files are cached.
  - *Outbound*: Delivered via native platform adapters (Matrix `m.file`, Email SMTP attachments, DingTalk Markdown `![image](url)`, Telegram native media). MCP base64 `ImageContent` results tagged with `MEDIA:<path>` are forwarded automatically.
- **Personas & Multi-Agent**:
  - *Per-Channel*: Define distinct system prompts per channel ID using `channel_prompts` in platform configs.
  - *Multi-Profile*: Multiplexed gateway mode runs isolated sessions, memory, skills, and credentials across profiles.
  - *Delegation*: The `delegate_task` tool spawns isolated child `AIAgent` instances (single or parallel batch).
- **Session Continuity**: Crashes/restarts set status to `resume_pending` to preserve transcripts. Restore via `/resume`. `session_reset` defaults to `mode: none`.

---

### 4. Memory, Skills & Tools
- **Core Memory Files**:
  - `~/.hermes/SOUL.md`: Agent persona, character, and instructions.
  - `~/.hermes/USER.md`: Persistent user profile and identity (`target="user"`).
  - `~/.hermes/MEMORY.md`: Long-term global facts and knowledge.
- **Local Honcho**: Accepts `base_url` without an API key and injects a `"local"` placeholder on localhost (`http://localhost:8000`).
- **Extending Tools & Memory**:
  - In-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed. Create standalone plugins implementing `MemoryProvider` ABC in `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
  - Add custom tools via plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` using `ctx.register_tool(...)` and enable them with `hermes plugins enable <name>`.
- **Skill Usage Telemetry**: Track skill executions recorded in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json` via `/insights` or `hermes insights`.
- **Turn Limits & Context Compression**:
  - `agent.max_turns` defaults to 90 (override with `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`).
  - For long autonomous tasks, use persistent Ralph loops via `/goal <task>` and continue paused runs with `/goal resume`.
  - Context bloat is managed by `ContextCompressor` (prunes verbose tool outputs) or pluggable `ContextEngine` ABC (`context.engine`).

---

### 5. Diagnostics, Observability & Security
- **Diagnostics**: Run `hermes doctor` to verify Python version, virtualenv, required packages, and auth status.
- **Tracing & Call Chains**: Enable built-in Langfuse tracing via `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse` to view nested traces and tool I/O.
- **Open WebUI**: SSE tool-progress streaming is enabled natively.
- **Security Vulnerabilities**: Report security issues privately via GitHub Security Advisories or email `security@nousresearch.com` (do not post public issues).
